question: Who among the following was known as the 'Queen of Thumri'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Girija Devi__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Girija Devi was dubbed as the 'Queen of Thumri' for her contribution in the genre.
 
• She was an Indian classical singer of the Seniya and Banaras gharanas.
 
• She performed classical and light classical music and helped elevate the profile of thumri. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gangubai Hangal was an Indian singer of the Khayal genre of Hindustani classical music from Karnataka, who was known for her deep and powerful voice.
 
• Siddheswari Devi the classical Hindustani singer from Varanasi, was adopted by noted sarangi player Siyaji Mishra.
